settings.withdrawNoticeTitle: Removing Acceptance or Deleting Local Data
settings.withdrawNoticeBody: Consent cannot be withdrawn inside the app while ledger data remains active. To stop using KamChi and erase all locally stored borrowers, loans, photos, and acceptance records:
settings.deleteStep1: 1. Optional: Export a JSON backup in Settings if you want to keep an offline copy of your records.
settings.deleteStep2: 2. Uninstall the KamChi app from your home screen, or open your browser settings and clear site storage / cookies for this site.
settings.deleteStep3: 3. Once site storage is cleared or the app is uninstalled, all local records and your acceptance record are permanently removed from this device.

termsSections.title: 1. About KamChi
body: KamChi is a record-keeping and loan management tool built for personal lenders. It helps you organize borrower details, repayment schedules, receipts, and reminders.
KamChi is not a bank, microfinance institution, licensed lender, payment processor, or financial or legal advisor.

termsSections.title: 2. Your Responsibility
body: You are solely responsible for your lending activities, including setting principal amounts, interest rates, late fees, and written or verbal agreements with your borrowers.
You agree to comply with all applicable laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

termsSections.title: 3. Your Data Stays on Your Device
body: Your borrower names, phone numbers, national ID photos, loan amounts, repayment schedules, and payment records are stored locally on your device in IndexedDB storage and are never automatically uploaded to KamChi servers.
If you optionally sign in with Google for personal cloud backup, your synced data is stored under your own authenticated Google account.

termsSections.title: 4. Backups
body: You are responsible for backing up your records regularly using the Backup & Restore export feature in Settings.
If your device is lost, damaged, stolen, reset, or if browser storage is cleared without a backup, your records cannot be recovered by KamChi.

termsSections.title: 5. Anonymous Usage Statistics (Optional)
body: By default, usage analytics are turned OFF. You can accept these Terms and use the entire app without enabling analytics, or change your choice anytime in Settings > Privacy.
Allowed: counts and bucketed ranges. Examples: number of loans, number of borrowers, share of loans that are overdue, loan size bucket ("$100-500"), and feature usage.
Still never sent: names, phone numbers, ID info, notes, license keys, device codes, free text, exact money amounts, exact dates of individual loans, or anything about a specific borrower.

"Per lender" means per install. GA4 gives each browser or phone a random anonymous ID. It lets us see "this lender has 12 loans" without knowing who they are. It resets if the user clears data or reinstalls, so it measures installs, not people.

termsSections.title: 6. What We Receive
body: We never see your borrowers' names, IDs, or loan details.

When you contact our seller to purchase a license key or ask for support, we only receive what you choose to send: your contact handle/number, the device code you copy to us, your chosen plan, and payment confirmation. If you turn on optional usage statistics, we also receive the anonymous aggregate counts and buckets described above.

termsSections.title: 7. Licenses
body: Paid license keys are verified offline inside the app without an internet connection.
Each license key is tied to the device code you choose to send to the seller. Moving to a new phone or clearing site data changes your device code and requires a new license key.

If your license expires past its grace period, KamChi switches to read-only mode so your existing borrowers, loans, and schedules stay visible and exportable at all times. You must not share or resell your key.

termsSections.title: 8. Borrower Information
body: You confirm that you have the legal right and borrower consent to record and store borrowers' and guarantors' personal information, national ID numbers, and photos on your device.
You agree to protect this information using device locks or the in-app PIN lock and handle it responsibly.

termsSections.title: 9. Calculations
body: Repayment schedules, interest totals, overdue counts, late fees, and currency conversions are calculated as a convenience tool.
You should always verify amounts and totals yourself before issuing a contract, collecting payment, or taking legal action.

termsSections.title: 10. No Warranty and Limits of Liability
body: KamChi is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, without warranties of uninterrupted availability or error-free operation.
To the extent allowed by law, KamChi and its creators are not liable for unpaid loans, borrower disputes, lost local data, or indirect or consequential losses.

termsSections.title: 11. Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these Terms and Conditions or our Privacy Policy from time to time.
When material changes are made, KamChi will show a summary of what changed and ask you to accept the updated version before continuing.

privacySections.title: 1. Your Data Stays on Your Device
body: KamChi is designed so your lending ledger stays on your own device. Borrower profiles, national ID images, contracts, payment history, and collector lists remain inside local IndexedDB storage on your device.

privacySections.title: 2. What We Receive & Offline Licenses
body: We never see your borrowers' names, IDs, or loan details.

License keys are verified offline inside the app without internet access and are tied to the device code you share with the seller (a new phone requires a new key). If you reach out to purchase a key or ask for support, we only receive the contact details, device code, chosen plan, and payment confirmation you send us.

privacySections.title: 3. Camera, Location & Notifications
body: Optional permissions such as camera (for ID/collateral photos), GPS check-in (for collection logs), and local alerts remain under your control on your device.

privacySections.title: 4. Anonymous Usage Statistics (Optional)
body: Usage analytics are OFF by default and only run when you explicitly opt in. Turning analytics off stops all sending immediately and clears Google Analytics cookies.
Allowed: counts and bucketed ranges. Examples: number of loans, number of borrowers, share of loans that are overdue, loan size bucket ("$100-500"), and feature usage.
Still never sent: names, phone numbers, ID info, notes, license keys, device codes, free text, exact money amounts, exact dates of individual loans, or anything about a specific borrower.

"Per lender" means per install. GA4 gives each browser or phone a random anonymous ID. It lets us see "this lender has 12 loans" without knowing who they are. It resets if the user clears data or reinstalls, so it measures installs, not people.

privacySections.title: 5. Deleting Your Local Data
body: Because KamChi stores records on your device, you can erase all local records at any time by clearing site storage for KamChi in your browser settings or uninstalling the installed PWA.
